0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-10, on a four-game losing streak and 0-6 at home) host the Portland Trail Blazers (7-3, on a one-game win streak) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group C play, the Kings' 12th game of the season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (out, foot bruise), Ja Morant (out, hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (out, ankle), and the Kings trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 128-120 loss in Sacramento on October 23, following a 0-4 series loss to Portland in 2025-26.
